column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/slow_tick_host_blocks.onsa tests=8 evaluated=6 unavailable=0 skipped=2 waiting=0
@ one call of 7 frames gives the values worked out
@ 3 frames and then 4 give the same: the second call holds the tick of the frame 4 at its 2nd frame
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=3 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=4 in x=[0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000]
@ a call of 0 frames before the first frame does not use the tick of the frame 0
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=0 in x=[]
@ calls of 3, 0 and 4 frames give the same
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=3 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=0 in x=[]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=4 in x=[0x40800000 0x40a00000 0x40c00000 0x40e00000]
- every cut of the run in three calls gives the same, the cuts at the ticks of sample / 4 and of sample / 2 and between
@ seven calls of one frame give the same
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x3f800000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40000000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40400000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40800000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40a00000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40c00000]
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40e00000]
@ a reset after 5 frames, in the middle of a phase, makes the next frame the frame 0 of a new run
- a reset after any number of frames, at a tick or between, gives the run of a state just made
